applicant.name: Dr. Nina Hofer
applicant.organisation: European research consortium on ageing (Horizon Europe)

request.purpose: Scientific research on multimorbidity in older adults as part of a publicly funded research project.
request.question: How many patients have hypertension, type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease, by hospital?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Cardiorenal-metabolic patient = patient with hypertension and type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
